## Goal

Make "won a game" a first-class, engine-generic achievement event so the give-away triggers have a real, Steam-free source.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AchievementSystem` (or a documented thin extension) gains an idempotent game-outcome surface (e.g. `onGameOutcome({ gameId, outcome })`) that unlocks mapped achievements via the existing `AchievementSink`; zero Steam/Electron imports.
- The launcher manifest defines `first-win` and `second-distinct-game-win` meta-achievements (titles, descriptions, hidden flags) and the outcome-to-achievement mapping is engine-generic.
- "Second distinct game" logic only unlocks after wins in two different game ids; re-wins of the same game do not.
- `SteamAchievementService` idempotence and offline paths are reused unchanged for the meta-achievements.
- Unit tests cover outcome-to-unlock, distinct-game counting, idempotence, and no-op for unknown outcomes; pass under `--project unit`.

## Key Files

- `src/core-engine/AchievementSystem.ts`
- `src/core-engine/index.ts`
- `electron/achievement-manifest.json`
- `tests/steam-achievements/achievement-outcome.test.ts` (new)

## Deliverables

Engine outcome surface, manifest meta-achievements, unit tests.
data.title: Engine game-outcome surface and cross-game meta-achievements

data.description:
# Goal

As a player on a WebGL boot, I want the Help panel, overlay dialog and Settings
panel scroll areas clipped to their visible region so overflowing content no
longer draws over panel chrome and the scene behind it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **Sites migrated.** `src/ui/HelpPanel.ts`, `src/ui/Overlay.ts`,
  `src/ui/SettingsPanel.ts` and `example-games/gym/scenes/GymOverlayUiScene.ts`
  no longer construct a `GeometryMask` directly for clipping; the three core UI
  sites in this item use the shared helper (the Gym scene is `CG-0MVTQ3W58004XN92`).
- **No Canvas regression.** Full core test suite green; Canvas rendering output
  unchanged (the Canvas branch keeps `GeometryMask`).
- `src/ui/HelpPanel.ts` (`setupScrollMask`), `src/ui/Overlay.ts`
  (`refresh()`) and `src/ui/SettingsPanel.ts` (the `_maxContentY > canvasHeight`
  branch) no longer construct `Phaser.Display.Masks.GeometryMask`; all three use
  `createContainerClip()` from `@ui/ContainerClip`.
- Under WebGL the mask Graphics is **off** the display list for all three
  (including `HelpPanel`, which currently adds it via `scene.add.graphics()` and
  exposes it in its children list).
- Re-clipping follows existing geometry: `setRect()` is applied on scroll mask
  updates, on panel slide-in/reposition and on resize; `clear()` is used when
  there is nothing to clip (`maxScroll <= 0` / content fits) — a zero-area rect
  is never used to mean "no clip".
- Teardown: `HelpPanel.destroy()` and `SettingsPanel.destroy()` call
  `clip.destroy()`; `Overlay`'s dialog `close()`/`dismissOverlay()` destroys the
  clip with the other overlay objects. `SettingsPanel` gains a tracked clip
  field (it currently keeps no reference to its mask Graphics).
- Full unit + build green; existing Canvas-path panel tests
  (`HelpSettingsButtons.test.ts`, `Overlay.test.ts`, `SettingsPanel.test.ts`,
  `SettingsPanel*.browser.test.ts`) still pass — Canvas output unchanged.
- `tests/ui/CorePanelWebglClip.browser.test.ts` boots each of the three panels
  under `Phaser.WEBGL` and asserts (a) content outside the scroll rect is not
  rendered (pixel probe, not a mock), (b) no core-originated
  `setMask … not supported in WebGL` warning, (c) close → reopen and
  `destroy()` leave no orphaned mask Graphics or active filter; the same file
  asserts Canvas parity for at least one panel.

## Key Files

- `src/ui/HelpPanel.ts`
- `src/ui/Overlay.ts`
- `src/ui/SettingsPanel.ts`
- `tests/ui/CorePanelWebglClip.browser.test.ts`
- `tests/ui/HelpSettingsButtons.test.ts`
- `tests/ui/Overlay.test.ts`
- `tests/ui/SettingsPanel.test.ts`

## Dependencies

- Blocked-by `CG-0MVTQ3UZL004YO8O` (core `ContainerClip` helper).

## Deliverables

- Three sites migrated + browser test green; commit references this item.
data.title: Migrate HelpPanel, Overlay and SettingsPanel clips to ContainerClip

data.description:
# Goal

As a Gym visitor, I want the scrollable overlay content clipped identically on
Canvas and WebGL, and the demo to teach the renderer-aware pattern rather than
the Canvas-only `GeometryMask` API.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymOverlayUiScene.ts` builds its scroll clip through
  `createContainerClip()`; it no longer constructs
  `Phaser.Display.Masks.GeometryMask` and no longer calls `setMask()` itself.
- The scene's help-panel text, class doc comment and `docs/gym/GYM_INDEX.md`
  entry describe **renderer-aware container clipping** (Canvas `GeometryMask` /
  WebGL Mask filter) instead of "GeometryMask clipping".
- Teardown on overlay close destroys the clip (no orphaned Graphics/filter).
- `tests/gym/GymOverlayUiScene.browser.test.ts` boots the scene under
  `Phaser.WEBGL`, asserts the scroll region clips (pixel probe) and that no
  core-originated `setMask … not supported in WebGL` warning is captured; the
  existing Canvas assertions remain green.
- Shared core panels reached through `GymSceneBase.initHelp` are already
  covered by the core-panel child — this item does not re-test them.

## Key Files

- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymOverlayUiScene.ts`
- `docs/gym/GYM_INDEX.md`
- `tests/gym/GymOverlayUiScene.browser.test.ts`
- `example-games/gym/scenes/GymSceneBase.ts`

## Dependencies

- Blocked-by `CG-0MVTQ3UZL004YO8O` (core `ContainerClip` helper).

## Deliverables

- Gym scene migrated + WebGL browser test green.
data.title: Migrate GymOverlayUiScene scroll clip to the core ContainerClip helper
